cat > /tmp/rolling_delete.sh << 'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
LOG=/tmp/ckpt_rolling_delete.log
BASE=/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints
EXPS="ablation_random_occ_s2 ablation_occ_detach_s2 depth_s2 depth_s3"

echo "$(date): Starting rolling delete monitor" > $LOG

for next_step in 30000 40000 50000; do
    prev_step=$((next_step - 10000))
    echo "$(date): === Phase: wait for ${next_step}, delete ${prev_step} ===" >> $LOG

    for exp in $EXPS; do
        # Wait for next_step checkpoint to appear
        while true; do
            found=$(find "$BASE/$exp" -maxdepth 1 -name "*--${next_step}_chkpt" -type d 2>/dev/null | head -1)
            if [ -n "$found" ]; then
                echo "$(date): FOUND $found" >> $LOG
                break
            fi
            sleep 300
        done

        # Delete prev_step checkpoint
        target=$(find "$BASE/$exp" -maxdepth 1 -name "*--${prev_step}_chkpt" -type d 2>/dev/null | head -1)
        if [ -n "$target" ]; then
            size_before=$(du -sh "$target" 2>/dev/null | cut -f1)
            echo "$(date): DELETING $target (${size_before})" >> $LOG
            rm -rf "$target"
            echo "$(date): DELETED $target" >> $LOG
        else
            echo "$(date): SKIP $exp - no ${prev_step}_chkpt found" >> $LOG
        fi
    done

    echo "$(date): Phase ${next_step} complete. Disk:" >> $LOG
    df -h /root/autodl-tmp >> $LOG
done

echo "$(date): === ALL DONE ===" >> $LOG
for exp in $EXPS; do
    echo "--- $exp ---" >> $LOG
    ls "$BASE/$exp" >> $LOG 2>&1
done
df -h /root/autodl-tmp >> $LOG
echo "ROLLING_DELETE_COMPLETE" >> $LOG
SCRIPT
chmod +x /tmp/rolling_delete.sh
echo "Script created"
